snippet.title: Wait they can climb?! - Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5484330/Wait_They_Can_Climb/

In this incremental Tower Defense you are alone on top of a building, surrounded by thousands of zombies. Place the turrets, grab the rifle and survive 10 days waiting for rescue. But be careful: they can climb!

#indiegame #indiegames #gamedev #towerdefense
